verdict.rationale: Angular ships a well-documented, official CLI (angular.dev/cli) covering workspace creation, build/serve, testing, e2e, i18n, linting, updates, library addition, config, deploy and caching — a mature first-party tool an AI agent could invoke to scaffold/build/test Angular apps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-agent-specific CLI usage or independent hands-on corroboration that AI tools successfully drive the CLI end-to-end.
